en: A sepia-toned photograph of a reservoir or lake with a stone turret-like structure with a conical roof in the foreground, set behind a wooden fence. The background shows a dam structure stretching across the water, surrounded by gently rolling, forested hills. The postcard has an old-fashioned look that suggests it is from the early 20th century. There is some text visible on the turret's entrance, but it is difficult to discern clearly.
